script_name: EasyTube V3 — Ad Skip, SponsorBlock & HD Download⬇️🚀
summary: The script transmits YouTube video IDs and possibly metadata to third-party endpoints (SponsorBlock and Cobalt instances) for ad skipping and video downloading. No evidence of sensitive data collection, remote code execution, code obfuscation, or DOM XSS. Permissions are appropriate and no sensitive browser APIs are used. Supply chain risk exists due to reliance on non-official Cobalt instances. Overall, the script is functional but carries high risk due to third-party data transmission.
